violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. MANAGER ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. MANAGER STATED THEY WERE SCHEDULED TO TAKE CFM EXAM SOON. EHS NOTIFIED MANAGER THAT ENFORCEMENT ACTIONS WOULD PROCEED DUE TO THREE TIME OBSERVED VIOLATION OF NO CFM PRESENT DURING INSPECTION.A FOLLOW UP INSPECTION WILL OCCUR ON OR AROUND 10 DAYS TO VERIFY A CFM IS PRESENT.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED VARIOUS CONTAINERS OF DRINKS STORED ON FLOOR OF WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. MOVE ALL DRINKS TO SHELVES IN WIC.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM present during entirety of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CFM must be present during all hours of operation. Have additional staff obtain CFM certification.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed hand sink at kiosk being used to rinse espresso cups.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS discussed with manager designated use of hand sink.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloth stored on counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS explained to PIC proper storage of wet wiping cloths.
